overview.intro: This workspace connects the SysML project “{{project}}” with the FreeCAD document “{{document}}”. The sync works in three areas:
overview.reviewTitle_one: {{count}} suggestion is waiting for your decision
overview.reviewTitle_other: {{count}} suggestions are waiting for your decision
overview.reviewText: Look at each suggestion: accept it or choose a measurement yourself.
overview.startTitle: No requirement is assigned to a measurement yet
overview.startText: The platform does not know yet where in FreeCAD to measure, say, the housing length – so it cannot check anything.
overview.checkText: The assigned requirements can now be checked against the FreeCAD model.
overview.recheckText: The FreeCAD or SysML model has changed since the last check.
overview.violatedText: Look at the measured values and adjust the CAD model or the requirement.
overview.restText: All assigned requirements are met. The others are only checked once they have a measurement.
overview.doneText: Optionally, provide the limits in FreeCAD so they can be used in formulas there.
overview.assignQ: Which measurement in FreeCAD belongs to which requirement? By suggestion or by hand.
overview.checkQ: Does the CAD model keep the limits from SysML? Measures in FreeCAD and compares.
overview.limitsQ: Writes the limits as reference values into a FreeCAD spreadsheet. The model itself does not change.
overview.models: What the platform reads from both models is under “Models”.
overview.unmeasuredText: Under “Check”, each one says why – e.g. an object that needs a recompute in FreeCAD.
overview.closedTitle: The FreeCAD document is not open

assign.title: Assign
assign.text: For each requirement, set where FreeCAD measures the value – e.g. “length of the housing”. Let the platform suggest assignments or choose them per row.

check.title: Check
check.text: The platform measures the assigned values in FreeCAD and compares them with the limits from SysML. Check again after every model change.
